summary.text: TaShina Morris, a Democrat, has represented District 77 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 2018 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: She earned an M.S. in leadership management from Amridge University in 2012 and a Ph.D. in criminal justice and safety studies from Capella University.
In her career, Morris served as a nonprofit director.
